text:
pat: FYI rc-2026.03.23 is blocked by SBOM/signature + one infra-level vuln flagged by scanner. Change window ends 17:00 PDT. Options: hold, pin digest and NA carveout, or proceed with sandboxed canary. Thoughts?

maria: paste deploybot output pls

deploy-bot: [automated] deploy:rc-2026.03.23 | status: blocked | reason: sbom_provenance_missing, vuln: INFRA-HIGH-2026-081 | image: gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe

ci-bot: vuln detail: INFRA-HIGH-2026-081 (glibc allocator backport) - severity high; mitigation: backport or runtime seccomp+mitigations (perf hit ~3%). SBOM signer: cosign timestamp absent; signer service returning 503s.

security: if signer ETA >30m prefer NA-limited canary + runtime hardening flag. Need documented engineering+security signoff and legal note for any regional carveout.

legal: legal needs customer-facing blurb if we delay EU. Also require release notes to include digest and a provenance follow-up action.

infra: route suggestion: `region =~ "us-.*" && header.x-canary=="rc-2026.03.23"` and flip `allow_eu_canary=false`. I can apply once pinned.

pat: proposal: 30m timebox for cosign evidence. If none, pin digest, NA-only canary with SECURE_MODE=1, 15min ramp to 10% traffic, 2h monitor. Rollback to rc-2026.03.22 on anomalies. Document everything in the release ticket.

maria: ok. Commands to use: ```
# pin the image with reason
deploy-bot pin --service=runtime --image=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe --reason="sbom-signing-delay" --expires=3h
```

pat: starting 30m clock now. tagging @security @legal.

ci-bot: signer poll +12m: keyserver degraded, retrying. no cosign yet.

pat: timebox hit. proceeding with pin and NA carveout.

pat: `deploy-bot pin --service=runtime --image=gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe --reason="sbom-signing-delay" --expires=3h` -> done

deploy-bot: pinned gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:deadbeefcafebabe | ttl=3h | scheduled canary in 10m | policy: region==us-* && header.x-canary=="rc-2026.03.23" | secure_mode=on

infra: applied route rule and flipped `allow_eu_canary=false`. low ramp starting. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/rc-2026.03.23-canary

security: running syscall and fuzz checks during canary. expect ~3% CPU delta.

maria: smoke tests passing first 10m. no errors so far.

ci-bot: signer poll +2h: cosign evidence appeared for deadbeefcafebabe. attaching provenance to artifact ticket.

pat: cosign backfilled. Plan: verify provenance attached and metrics stable for 1h, then promote to EU/global and unpin. Legal to send customer note if required.

legal: drafting EU message; will send if carveout extends beyond immediate promote.

infra: monitoring green.

pat: thanks all. updating release ticket with digest and provenance link, closing thread.
